title: 蒙多·玩偶小医生
description: 紫色蒙多穿完整白色外衣，给毛绒玩偶系好围巾，医疗道具只是普通玩具。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Dr. Mundo is a huge purple-skinned adult with an exaggerated square jaw, small dark hair tuft, broad nose, and a goofy friendly grin. Preserve his oversized silhouette and white coat motif, but make the coat intact over an opaque shirt and trousers. Any cleaver-like signature prop is safely stored in a closed wall holder, without needles, wounds, or disturbing medical detail.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a sturdy stool and ties a little checked scarf around a soft teddy bear as if carefully looking after a patient. A toy stethoscope rests on the table but never touches a person. Keep the room bright and simple, with a round window and a tiny flowerpot emphasizing his gentle oversized hands.
art_direction.palette: lavender purple, coat white, mint, soft red
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
